title: Sebastian and the Verdict
premise: When archivist Emrys Ravensworth discovers that missing parishioner Maren Quill's diary contains entries written after her disappearance, they realize the crypt's locked door hides not a body but a living secret — and someone in the cathedral has been maintaining the fiction of her death for two decades. As the tide begins to erode the sea wall beneath the crypt, exposing what was buried there, Emrys must use their twenty years of filed secrets to identify which trusted colleague orchestrated the cover-up. In the end, Emrys traps the killer with a forged archive entry, chooses truth over the found family that loyalty demanded, and inherits custody of both the crypt's remains and the town's unfinished reckoning.
about_author: Silas Thornbury is the pen name of a former parish records clerk who spent eleven years cataloguing documents no one was meant to read again. They write mysteries about people who mistake order for safety.

chapters.title: The Alphabet of Absence
chapters.summary: Emrys Ravensworth, POV. While re-cataloguing the sealed crypt's overflow files, Emrys finds Maren Quill's diary and notices entries continuing three weeks past her disappearance date. The emotional beat is quiet dread: the archivist who trusts paper above people realizes the paper has been lying to them for twenty years.

chapters.title: What the Tide Keeps
chapters.summary: Emrys, POV, alternating with diary excerpts. Investigating with reluctant ally Detective Idris Vane, Emrys learns the crypt lock was changed the week after Maren vanished — by someone with keys. Suspicion circles the cathedral's tight circle of caretakers, the only family Emrys has known. Beat: loyalty curdles into doubt as every suspect feels like kin.

chapters.title: A Verdict in Ink
chapters.summary: Emrys, POV. The storm surge cracks the sea wall; the crypt will flood within days. Emrys plants a false archive entry claiming the original diary pages survive, forcing the killer — Canon Aldous Wren, who wrote the post-disappearance entries to stage Maren's flight — to break into the archive at night. Beat: terror and resolve as the trap springs.

chapters.title: Sebastian's Inheritance
chapters.summary: Emrys and Idris, POV shared. Confronted among the flooding shelves, Wren confesses he killed Maren when she threatened to expose the cathedral's embezzled restoration funds. The tide gives up her remains; Emrys testifies against the man who taught them the archives, then reopens every sealed file. Beat: grief transmuted into purpose — truth as the true inheritance.
